pages.title: A quiet morning · 1/3
paragraphs: It is early morning in a quiet yoga studio in San Diego. Soft music plays and the room smells like lavender. Bea stands at the door with a small bag. Around her, people lay out colorful mats. A calm woman named Mai greets her. She smiles and points to the shelf.
“Welcome to yoga class! Is this your first time?” says Mai. “Yes. Do I need a mat?” says Bea. “Yes. You can borrow one from the shelf.” says Mai.

pages.title: A quiet morning · 3/3
paragraphs: “What if a pose is too hard?” says Bea. “Don’t worry. Listen to your body and rest.” says Mai. Bea leaves her shoes by the door and takes a mat. A quiet hour can change a whole day.
